cards.topup_fee_notes: 0% from OKX Wallet
cards.staking_requirement: None
cards.requirements_text: Light KYC, EEA residency, OKX Wallet
cards.description: OKX's card is a virtual-only Mastercard that draws from the self-custody OKX Wallet. It is a useful companion for DeFi users in Europe who want Apple Pay without moving funds to a centralized exchange, though the lack of a physical card limits it.
pros: Self-custody funding
0% top-up fee
Apple Pay support

cards.name: Fold Card
cards.tagline: Bitcoin rewards on debit spending, plus a spin-to-earn game.
cards.fx_fee_notes: 3% foreign transaction fee
cards.topup_fee_notes: Free bank top-ups; 1.5% crypto conversion
cards.staking_requirement: None
cards.description: Fold is a Bitcoin-first debit card with a gamified rewards layer. The base cashback is modest, but the occasional boosted merchants and spin wheel can push effective returns higher. Best for US Bitcoin maximalists who already use the Fold app.
pros: Bitcoin-native rewards
No annual fee
Fun boosted-merchant offers

cards.name: Plutus Card
cards.tagline: Stake PLU for up to 8% cashback and airport lounge access.
cards.fx_fee_notes: 1.5% FX; 0.5% weekend markup
cards.topup_fee_notes: 1% crypto top-up
cards.staking_requirement: Stake from 25 to 1,000 PLU
cards.requirements_text: Full KYC, UK/EEA residency, PLU stake
cards.description: Plutus still offers one of the highest nominal cashback rates in Europe, but the 8% ceiling requires a large PLU stake, a monthly reward cap and a subscription. The card works well for high-spend users who are comfortable with token risk; casual users will find the fee stack and reward mechanics frustrating.
pros: High headline cashback
Lounge access at higher tiers
No annual fee

cards.name: BitPay Card
cards.tagline: Convert crypto to fiat and spend anywhere Mastercard is accepted.
cards.fx_fee_notes: 3% on non-USD transactions
cards.topup_fee_notes: 1.5% crypto-to-USD conversion
cards.staking_requirement: None
cards.description: BitPay's card is a legacy prepaid product with a high fee stack: 1.5% to load and 3% on foreign spend. It remains useful for US users who want a physical Mastercard tied to BitPay's merchant network, but it is no longer competitive on cost.
pros: Simple crypto-to-fiat conversion
Physical and virtual cards
No credit check
